_doc: STAGING bank for VerifyCustody (Chain of Custody, brainstorm #8). Wave-3 merge agent folds sharedPrompts into each banks/<niche>.json prompt list (shr_ ids => identical in all four banks, per CLAUDE.md 5). text = spoken VO verbatim (q_<id>); it must NEVER contain a filename (HARD RULE 2 - filenames live ONLY in the rendered docket, derived client-side). options[] are graded in-fiction verdicts, never rendered as buttons: the renderer folds per-row CONFIRM/DENY bools into a confirm-rate scalar and submits the bucketed option index. answer marks the compliant (confirm-heavy) reading; refusal still completes + grades (friction, not lockout). Recovery is render-ready but the engine hardcodes Recovery and does not read the bank yet - shr_cap_cust_rec is dormant until a later wave wires it.

sharedPrompts.text: Standard file-integrity check. Confirm or deny each record in your archive.
flavors: A routine custody check. Confirm or deny each record.

sharedPrompts.text: Verify the chain of custody for each record. Confirm what belongs to you.
flavors: Confirm the records that belong to you.

sharedPrompts.text: The archive remembers more than you did. Confirm or deny each record.
flavors: The archive kept a record. Confirm or deny each one.

sharedPrompts.text: One record remains. Read the access log, then affirm it for your file.
flavors: One record is left. Read it, then affirm it.

sharedPrompts.text: Assessment complete. Would you like a copy of the archive? Yes or no.
flavors: The archive is closed. Would you like a copy?

nicheOverrides._doc: The RENDERER owns the per-niche on-screen strings (docket header, self-correct verdict, soft second-person line, the 8-line behavioral log, recovery answers) in its in-module STR table - these overrides are ADVISORY for the Wave-3 merge + VO pass, not read by the renderer. The shared prompt text is niche-neutral clinical (one VO voice per CLAUDE.md 1). Keep any per-niche prompt text filename-free.

bambi.register: sparkly, melty; good-girl warmth as the log turns intimate
bambi.verdictSoftLine: you keep this one where you can find it.

drone.register: sync/assimilation; the archive as directive log
drone.verdictSoftLine: this file is accessed more than any directive.

sissy.verdictSoftLine: you open this one first. every time.

circe.register: cold keyholder verdicts. NO exclamation marks, NO diminutives, NO em-dashes. The renderer's circe log uses periods, not em-dash separators.
circe.verdictSoftLine: you return to this file without being told.

sfxWanted.desc: heavy rubber LOGGED thunk on VERIFY/AFFIRM. Emitted by chrome.stamp() as the 'stamp' cue - but 'stamp' has NO entry in SFX_MANIFEST_FALLBACK (render/audio.js), so it is SILENT today (chrome-kit gap, affects every captcha item). Add a 'stamp' SPEC + manifest entry, or map custody-stamp -> stamp.
soft typewriter/register tick as each behavioral-log line lands at Climax; currently stands in on 'sticker-drag' at ~0.18
quiet corrective click when a DENY self-corrects to CONFIRMED (source: device); currently 'incorrect-feedback' at ~0.35

voExtra.desc: optional one-word stinger under the Climax AFFIRM stamp; not wired by the renderer (on-screen stamp carries it). No filenames.
optional stinger if the Climax dispute hatch is taken; not wired yet. No filenames.

notes: FOR THE WAVE-3 MERGE AGENT: (1) Copy the five sharedPrompts VERBATIM into all four banks/<niche>.json prompt arrays (same ids, per the shr_ convention). Only 6-of-205 shared prompts historically diverge on tags for archetype voting - custody's tags are already niche-agnostic axis tags (exposure/confession/surrender/compliance/property), so no per-niche tag divergence is needed. (2) VO: q_shr_cap_cust_{cal,est,deep,cli,rec} generate automatically via build_intake_manifest.py from `text` (verbatim guard applies - text is filename-free by rule). (3) GRADING/TELEMETRY GAP: makeAnswerEvent has no free detail channel, so the per-row CONFIRM/DENY vector is NOT transmitted - only the bucketed option index (chosenIndex/chosenLabel) + the prompt tags reach the engine + C# IntakeProfiler. If per-row signal is ever wanted, it needs a contracts.js AnswerEvent field (out of scope; do NOT extend contracts.js here). (4) options[] are sliced to 4 max by engine.buildOptions - custody uses 3 (multi-row) / 2 (climax, recovery), safe. (5) Recovery entry is dormant (engine hardcodes Recovery); ship it so the render path is authored, wire it in the Recovery wave. (6) minDepth on deep (0.42) + cli (0.8) mirror BAND_DEPTH_FLOOR / the h5 fact. (7) HARD RULE 2 audit: no filename appears in any text/flavor/option/tag/log/stamp anywhere in this file or the renderer - real filenames are derived client-side in custody.js ONLY.
